oddities: Hard-coded hex in PLANNED_STRIPES: '#93c5fd' and '#dbeafe' (Tailwind blue-300/blue-100) via inline backgroundImage — outside the brand trio and not a Tailwind class, so it will not respond to theme changes.

Four separate blue/green families in one card: earned=bg-blue-600, enrolled=bg-sky-400, planned=blue-300/100 stripes, success=emerald-500/600, year badge=teal-50/200/700, brand button=#153974. Neither #3069B3 nor #00AACA is used for progress; teal is a fourth accent not in the brand trio.
Focus ring on selects is focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 (Tailwind blue), not brand #153974/#00AACA; CustomCourseForm select has NO focus style at all.

Three different native <select> recipes: 'flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm' (CustomCourseForm), 'w-full text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-white text-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500' (RequirementForm cutoff), 'text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 bg-white text-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500' (RequirementForm year).

Field label scale differs by context: text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1 (RequirementForm) vs text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1 (CustomCourseForm) vs text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2 (AddSemesterDialog).

Dialog title scale inconsistent: text-2xl font-semibold (no color, AddSemesterDialog) vs text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 (CustomCourseForm) vs text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 (inline editor heading).

Footer button order and cancel variant inconsistent: CustomCourseForm = [ghost 취소][primary 추가] gap-3 both flex-1; AddSemesterDialog = [primary 추가][outline 취소] gap-3 both flex-1; RequirementForm = [primary 저장/수정 flex-1][outline 취소 natural width] gap-2.
Two loading-button patterns: Button isLoading prop (RequirementForm, AddSemesterDialog) vs manual text swap '...중...' + disabled (RequirementsSummary, CustomCourseForm).

Modal overlay A (CustomCourseForm) has p-4 gutter and max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto; overlay B (AddSemesterDialog) has neither, so the panel can touch screen edges and overflow on short viewports. A uses a raw div panel with shadow-xl; B reuses Card.

Accessibility: neither modal sets role="dialog"/aria-modal/aria-labelledby or traps focus. CustomCourseForm has no Escape or backdrop-click close and no close button; AddSemesterDialog has both. AddSemesterDialog's Escape listener is attached even when closed (guarded by isOpen check inside).
Red text shades vary by context: text-red-500 (field + form errors), text-red-600 (query error), text-red-700 (duplicate warning). Amber varies too: text-amber-600 vs text-amber-800.

Contrast: text-gray-400 at text-[10px]/text-[11px]/text-xs is used for legends, captions and the footer hint — roughly 2.5–3:1 on white/gray-50, below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for body text. text-red-500 at text-xs (~4:1) is also borderline. text-teal-700 on bg-teal-50 at 10px is small but passes.
Three micro-type tiers coexist: text-[10px] (badge), text-[11px] (legend/sub rows/hint), text-xs (12px). Arbitrary sizes bypass the Tailwind scale.
Magic numbers: pl-[72px] (= w-16 + gap-2) to align the legend; rounded-[2px] on swatches (one-off radius); max-h-[90vh].
'요건 수정' and the amber suggestion CTA are raw <button> elements with bespoke classes instead of the shared Button component; the amber one uses `rounded` (4px) while everything else uses rounded-md.
Brand tint button uses opacity modifiers on an arbitrary hex (bg-[#153974]/10, hover:bg-[#153974]/20) — works in Tailwind v4 but is a bespoke tertiary style not defined centrally.

Links: RequirementForm uses next/link <Link> with text-[#00AACA] hover:text-[#153974] underline; CustomCourseForm uses a plain <a href="/profile"> with only 'underline font-medium' (inherits amber), causing a full page load and an unbranded link color.
Native radio inputs (w-4 h-4) with no accent-color class, so the checked color is the browser default blue, not brand.

border-t / border-b / border used without an explicit color in RequirementsSummary and RequirementForm; in Tailwind v4 the default border color is currentColor unless globals.css overrides it, so these rules may render darker than intended.
Mixed border widths: border-2 on segmented buttons vs border (1px) everywhere else.
Term button in AddSemesterDialog has no explicit text size (inherits base 16px) while the grade button sets text-sm — mismatched within the same dialog.
Copy inconsistency: title '졸업 요건' (with space) vs error '졸업요건 정보를…' (no space). Validation messages omit the trailing period while status/success messages include it.
BreakdownLine docstring describes '·' separators but the rendered markup uses gap-x-2.5 only; the middle dot appears only in the footer hint copy.
Year select hard-codes two options (2025년, 2026년) rather than deriving from data.
Hero percentage uses total.percentage >= 100 while bars/rows use earned >= required via isMet — two parallel 'met' computations.
RequirementsSummary edit-mode header row is 'flex items-center justify-between mb-3' but contains only one child (no right-side action).
RequirementForm numeric grid is grid-cols-2 with no mobile breakpoint; at phone width each Input gets ~140px, tight for label '복수전공핵심 (최소)'.
Loading-state skeleton is a single h-4 bar that does not mirror the eventual card layout.
